name: v3-auth-failure
description: A rejected credential. get_token returns None, and passing that None to bearer() used to abort the run with a type error (verified against the real scanner) instead of stopping cleanly. The run must end with zero assets, a printed diagnostic, and no asset request ever issued.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR rather than reporting a successful run with zero assets: a refused credential and an empty tenant are otherwise the same result, and only the exit status separates them.
